subject: Renewal onboarding refresh & capacity increase — Acme Corp
messages:
From: Sara Kline <sara.kline@acmecorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tony Lee <tony.lee@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal & vendor onboarding refresh — Acme Corp

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Our renewal for Redwood is coming up in June and procurement is asking us to do a vendor onboarding refresh before we sign the renewal amendment. We're also planning to increase our reserved capacity (from 2 Dedicated units to 5) starting at the next term. Before we surface the change to procurement, can you confirm the steps and documents you need from Acme? Specifically: 

- Updated W-9 and SOC 2 attestation (we can attach)
- Vendor onboarding form / procurement portal URL for vendor re-verification
- Pricing for a 24-month term vs 12-month and the cost for 5 units (vs current 2)
- Any change to billing cadence (we prefer net-30) and the PO process

Our procurement contact is Tony Lee (cc'd) — PO will be issued from Acme Inc. Legal has asked whether changing the term to 24 months is possible and whether a staged increase (pilot for 3 months at 3 units, then 5) is supported.

I've attached our internal renewal request summary for context. Please let me know what you need from us to get vendor onboarding refreshed in your portal and the expected timeline so we can coordinate procurement.

Thanks,
Sara Kline
Director, Cloud Infrastructure
Acme Corp
Attachment: Acme_Renewal_Request.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kline <sara.kline@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & vendor onboarding refresh — Acme Corp

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear summary. Happy to own the vendor side of this. Quick answers + next steps: 

1) Documents we need from Acme to start onboarding refresh: updated W-9, point-of-contact for finance, SOC2 (PDF) or letter of attestation, and the completed onboarding questionnaire (I can send the form).

2) Procurement portal: we have a vendor onboarding portal for renewals/refreshes. I'll send the portal link and a checklist. Typical turnaround is 3–5 business days after we receive complete docs.

3) Pricing / term: I'll prepare a preliminary quote for both 12- and 24-month terms with capacity breakdown for 3 and 5 Dedicated units and share an estimate today. If Acme can move to a 24-month commit we typically offer a term discount (I will propose two options: immediate 5-unit commit vs staged pilot→ramp).

4) Billing / PO: Net-30 is fine; please confirm the exact billing entity and PO number when available. If you have a preferred invoice remit address that helps speed processing.

Action items from our side (I'll do these by EOD PT):
- Send vendor onboarding portal link + questionnaire (attachment: renewal_checklist.xlsx)
- Share preliminary pricing (attachment: pricing_estimate_v1.pdf)
- Kick off internal legal review for a 24-month amendment draft

If you can return the W-9 and SOC2 link and confirm the PO #, I can push this through the onboarding portal and into our billing queue.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: renewal_checklist.xlsx; pricing_estimate_v1.pdf
From: Sara Kline <sara.kline@acmecorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Tony Lee <tony.lee@acmecorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T08:20:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & vendor onboarding refresh — Acme Corp

Thanks, Rishi — looping procurement.

Procurement notes: PO will be issued as PO #54321 (Acme Inc.). Billing entity: Acme Inc., remit-to address in the attached questionnaire. We will confirm W-9 and SOC2 link by EOD. Net-30 is acceptable.

A couple of portal-specific items: 
- Our procurement team requires that vendor re-verification be submitted through our procurement portal: https://procure.acmecorp.com/vendor-onboarding/refresh?token=abc123
- The portal requires a point of contact, an updated W-9, and a completed procurement questionnaire (I've attached the PDF).

We'd prefer to see the amendment and pricing options before committing to 24 months, but are open to a pilot approach as you suggested (3 months at 3 units, then escalate if SLA and latency targets are met).

Attached: Acme_Procurement_Questionnaire.xlsx

Regards,
Sara Kline
Director, Cloud Infrastructure
Acme Corp
Attachment: Acme_Procurement_Questionnaire.xlsx
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kline <sara.kline@acmecorp.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & vendor onboarding refresh — Acme Corp

Hi all — quick internal note and recommendation from CS/Commercial: 

- Term: Moving Acme to 24 months will require an executive sign-off for the discount level. I recommend offering a 12–15% effective discount for an immediate 24-month commit, or a 6–8% uplift for a staged pilot→full approach.

- Capacity pricing: For 5 Dedicated units we should propose a blended rate that reflects the reserved capacity economics. Attached is a draft amendment we can use as a starting point (amendment_draft.docx).

- Procurement portal: once Rishi uploads the completed questionnaire and W-9 to the portal, billing can provision net-30 invoices against PO #54321. Finance will need the remit-to address and EIN (please include in the questionnaire).

Rishi — can you loop legal (I will put legal on the amendment thread) and confirm we will propose both pilot and full-commit options in the quote? Also confirm if SCIM/SSO changes are required for Acme's private deployment so SRE can plan for onboarding windows.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Attachment: amendment_draft.docx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Thanks everyone — quick summary and next steps (action owner in parentheses):

1) Acme to upload W-9, SOC2 link, and completed procurement questionnaire in the Acme portal (Acme / Sara) — PO #54321 confirmed.
2) Rishi to submit the onboarding questionnaire and W-9 into our vendor portal and attach to deal record (Rishi) — done by EOD PT.
3) Commercial to provide two pricing options: (a) 24-month commit at proposed term discount, (b) staged pilot (3 months at 3 units then ramp to 5) with a slightly higher monthly rate (Monica / Marissa).
4) Legal to review and finalize amendment for DocuSign (Legal) — tentative doc link: https://app.redwood.com/docusign/3f2a1b. Monica will add legal to the thread.
5) Finance to accept PO #54321 and confirm remit-to details once onboarding docs are in place (Finance).

I attached the onboarding checklist and preliminary pricing that I sent earlier. Once we have the completed questionnaire and W-9, I'll push the vendor update through our portal and ping procurement. I've also attached the HubSpot deal so we all have the canonical record.
